About Organization

The Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) is a government organization responsible for conducting various recruitment exams in the state of Uttar Pradesh. The organization aims to provide employment opportunities to eligible candidates in different government departments.
The UPSSSC is committed to transparency and fairness in its recruitment process, ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate and get selected for their desired posts.

About the Programme

The UPSSSC Junior Engineer Agriculture Main Examination 2026 is a recruitment exam conducted by the Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) to select eligible candidates for the post of Junior Engineer in the Agriculture department. The exam is a great opportunity for candidates who want to work in the government sector and contribute to the development of the agriculture industry in Uttar Pradesh.
The UPSSSC Junior Engineer Agriculture Main Examination 2026 is a competitive exam, and candidates need to prepare well to get selected for the post. The exam will test the candidate's knowledge, skills, and abilities in various subjects related to agriculture engineering.
